issue.name: SQL injection
issue.issueDetail: The q parameter appears to be vulnerable to SQL injection attacks. The payload '||pg_sleep(10)-- was submitted in the q parameter and the application took 10,214 milliseconds to respond, compared with 188 milliseconds for the original request. A UNION-based payload returned the database version (PostgreSQL 14.5) in the employee table.
issue.remediationDetail: Use parameterised queries for every database call. The directory search builds its WHERE clause by string concatenation in search.py.

issue.name: Cross-site scripting (stored)
issue.issueDetail: The value of the about_me parameter is stored and later rendered unencoded on /directory/person/<id>. The payload <img src=x onerror=alert(document.domain)> executed when another user viewed the profile.
issue.remediationDetail: HTML-encode user input on output and add a Content-Security-Policy.

issue.name: Cookie without HttpOnly flag set
issue.issueDetail: The session cookie PORTALSESSID is issued without the HttpOnly flag.
issue.remediationDetail: Set HttpOnly (and Secure, SameSite=Lax) on the session cookie.

issue.name: Password field with autocomplete enabled
issue.issueDetail: The login form's password field does not set autocomplete="off".
issue.remediationDetail: Rely on a password manager-friendly policy; low priority.

issue.name: Strict transport security not enforced
issue.issueDetail: The application does not send a Strict-Transport-Security header.

issue.name: Software version disclosed in Server header
issue.remediationDetail: Set server_tokens off in the nginx configuration.
